params.body:
Phase 1, step 4 of `docs/design/sources-before-more-sources.md`.

Four adapters each carried their own copy of "start the run, wait, fetch the
dataset", and each copy believed the vendor's status. That belief is what kept
TikTok silent from 12 May: the actor ended every run `SUCCEEDED` with the message
"Total 2 requests: 0 succeeded, 2 failed", and `SUCCEEDED` was all anybody read.

## `packages/adapters/apify.mjs`, the one place

- Reads the actor's own status message and **throws when a run "succeeded" with
  every request failed**.
- **Out of time is an error.** One copy polled thirty times and then fetched the
  dataset anyway, so a run of sixty-four seconds was read at sixty.
- A refusal at the start carries its type (`actor-is-not-rented`), the part a
  person can act on.
- **A contract per adapter.** A required field absent from *every* item is a
  changed output and throws; absent from some is ordinary data.
- Takes a fixed build and a per-run charge ceiling, and returns what Apify says
  the run cost. `adapter_runs` records that bill when there is one: a bill is a
  fact, a declared price is a guess.

`tiktok-trends`, `instagram-search`, `pinterest-trends` and `china-hotrank` run on
it. A test fails if an active adapter talks to Apify by itself again.

## On pinning: a refinement of rule 5

`china-hotrank` is pinned to `0.0.9`. It has not changed since February and
carries six platforms that deliver daily, so `latest` could only take something
away. The Instagram and TikTok actors ship builds weekly against sites that keep
moving (TikTok's latest build is three days old); there the maintainer's fixes
are the value and the contract is the protection, so they stay on `latest`.

## Proven live before proposing

Run from the box against Apify with this exact file:

```
hot-rank: 50 items | build 0.0.9 | $0.00029 | fields: hot_word, hot_value, label, url, desc
tiktok:   THROWN -> the run ended SUCCEEDED but every request failed (Total 1 requests: 0 succeeded, 1 failed.)
```

763 tests pass, 13 new. Next: the measurement in `/api/elixir` and its judgement
in Elixir.
params.title: One way to run an Apify actor, and it does not believe the vendor
